intro.title: The idea behind SilkCover
paragraphs: Afghanistan needs credible local institutions capable of producing sound evidence and translating it into practical action. Public institutions, businesses, development organisations and civil society often face complex questions about services, markets, organisational performance and changing social conditions.

SilkCover responds by combining local understanding, professional methodology and practical delivery. We aim to be more than a company that produces reports: our role is to help clients move from a question to reliable evidence, realistic options and, where requested, implementation support.

Constructive working relationships support lawful coordination and an understanding of local requirements. Our analysis remains independent: such relationships never influence findings or imply official endorsement.

items.title: Global perspective
items.text: We bring together Afghan knowledge and networks with national and international professional expertise, so our work stands up to scrutiny wherever it is used.

items.title: Cultural depth
items.text: Complex questions need technical knowledge and an understanding of the Afghan context. Local understanding shapes every method we choose.

items.title: Strategic thinking
items.text: Professional methodology and practical delivery move clients from a question to reliable evidence, realistic options and, where requested, implementation support.

items.title: Vision
items.text: To become a trusted Afghan consultancy with a growing regional and international presence, recognised for professional integrity, reliable research, innovative thinking and practical solutions.

items.title: Mission
items.text: To help institutions, businesses and organisations understand challenges, strengthen their capacities and achieve meaningful results.

items.title: Integrity and independence
items.text: Findings are never influenced by relationships, and research is never manipulated for communication purposes.

items.title: Reliable evidence
items.text: Each study distinguishes verified evidence from interpretation, identifies gaps and explains its limitations.

items.title: Responsible technology
items.text: AI tools are tested for accuracy and security, and important decisions stay under human oversight.

paragraphs: Our visual identity draws on girih, the strapwork geometry found in the tilework of Herat’s historic architecture. Girih patterns are built with compass and straightedge from a few simple rules, yet they produce figures of great complexity and balance.

We see the same idea in good consulting: separate disciplines, drawn with care, that fit together into one coherent piece of work. The pointed arch that frames our images and pages comes from the same architectural tradition.
